A '''Zygerrian scout''' operated under the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]]. The scout served under [[Raney]] in [[Old Ord Mantell City]] on [[Ord Mantell]]. After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba's]] pet [[rancor]], [[Muchi]], was kidnapped by the [[enslaver]]s, [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] sent out [[Clone Force 99]] to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|rescue Muchi]]. The mission failed, as almost all of [[Cloning|Clone]] Force 99 was captured, except for [[Omega]]. This [[scout]] was sent to check the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']] for any living life forms, but Omega snuck through a shaft in the [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|ship]] and hid behind some rocks. The scout and his cohort then reported that the ship was clear and sped back to base.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Zygerrian scout appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]],"<ref name="Rampage" /> the fifth episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 28]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Matthew Wood]].<ref name="Rampage" />
